name: modelscope
description: ModelScope CLI: pip install modelscope provides the modelscope command. Subcommands: login / download / upload / create / scan-cache / clear-cache / llamafile / server / plugin / skills / modelcard / pipeline. Uploading additionally requires git and git-lfs.

metadata.install: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install modelscope (uploads also need git + git-lfs)
metadata.env_hint: MODELSCOPE_API_TOKEN (written by modelscope login, or an environment variable on the server process)
